hooks.command: P="${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if [ -x "$P/hooks/run.sh" ]; then "$P/hooks/run.sh" session-start || true; elif command -v bro >/dev/null 2>&1; then ( bro hooks session-start & c=$!; ( sleep 8; kill "$c" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; kill -9 "$c" 2>/dev/null ) >/dev/null 2>&1 & w=$!; wait "$c" 2>/dev/null; kill "$w" 2>/dev/null ) || true; fi; exit 0
